title: Vector bundle with zero section
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning a scheme with a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $d\in\mathbb N$. Let $\mathcal E$ be a locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module of constant finite rank $d$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

Use the symmetric algebra sheaf $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Sym}^{\bullet}_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal E)$ with generator map $j:\mathcal E\to\mathcal A$ constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. Its quasi-coherence and its identification on an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $\operatorname{Sym}_R(\mathcal E(U))$ are supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra-affine]; its algebra universal property is [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra-core]. The vector bundle associated to $\mathcal E$ is the relative affine scheme
$$
\pi:E=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\longrightarrow S
$$
of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec]. Concretely its affine pieces are $\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Sym}_R(\mathcal E(U)))$ with structural maps induced by $R\to\operatorname{Sym}_R(\mathcal E(U))$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], glued by the restriction maps in that relative-spectrum construction.

The augmentation $\epsilon:\mathcal A\to\mathcal O_S$ is the unique morphism of $\mathcal O_S$-algebras satisfying $\epsilon\circ j=0$. Its corresponding $S$-morphism $z:S\to E$ under [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](3) is called the zero section. On each affine piece it is induced by the augmentation $\operatorname{Sym}_R(\mathcal E(U))\to R$, which is the identity on $R$ and sends every degree-one generator to zero. Thus $\epsilon$ composed with the structural inclusion is the identity and $\pi\circ z=\mathrm{id}_S$. The zero section is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]: on affine pieces the augmentation is surjective, and its spectrum is the quotient closed subscheme defined by its kernel.

A trivialization on a Zariski open $V\subseteq S$ is a choice $\mathcal E|_V\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus d}$. It induces $E|_V:=\pi^{-1}(V)\cong\mathbf A^d_V$ over $V$, with affine space as in [def-sbc-affine-space], by restriction in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](4) and the basis-to-polynomial identification [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-free-module-polynomial]. In these coordinates $z$ is $x_1=\cdots=x_d=0$. On an overlap $W$ two frames are related by $e'_j=\sum_{i=1}^d g_{ij}e_i$, where $G=(g_{ij})$ is a $d$-by-$d$ matrix with entries in $\mathcal O_S(W)$ and with an inverse over that ring. The induced coordinates satisfy $x'_j=\sum_i g_{ij}x_i$; these invertible coordinate substitutions are the changes of trivialization.

proof.text: For augmentation_spec apply the unique extension property to the zero module map. This gives vanishing on generators and uniqueness. Identify its composite with the sectionwise sheafification unit with algebraMapInv by SymmetricAlgebra.induction: Under.w gives the scalar case, generator vanishing gives the degree-one case, and both sides preserve sums and products. For efficient reduction, construct the structure-algebra functor on objects and section maps, prove it naturally isomorphic to the characterized functor of the relative-spectrum theorem, and use its equivalence with the resulting quasi-inverse. This realizes the same relative-spectrum construction up to the unique algebra-compatible isomorphism.

For zero_spec the preimage defining zero is a morphism over S, so Over.w proves zero composed with the projection equals the identity. The projection is affine by its defining full subcategory, hence separated. Apply Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.of_comp to this section identity to obtain the closed immersion.

For affineChart_naturality apply Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map to the inclusion of inverse-image opens, combine the Spec maps, and use naturality of algebraIso and of the sheafification unit to identify the section-ring maps.

The affineChart_spec IsIso clause follows from the relative-spectrum chart and the affine symmetric-algebra section bijectivity. Its two compatibility equations are supplied by the split theorem affineChart_equations, which is the strict equation part of this step.

For trivializationMap_spec, transport the free-sheaf frame to a basis of sections on each affine open of the framed open. SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial sends the basis generators to polynomial variables. Naturality of the frame sections, the symmetric-algebra inclusion, and the counit shows that the resulting affineChart composite is the restriction of trivializationMap. The affine-space maps of the affine cover form an open cover of the target, and the comparison squares are pullbacks. Isomorphisms are Zariski local at the target, so trivializationMap is an isomorphism. The augmentation kills each frame section, and AffineSpace.hom_ext identifies the zero section with the origin.

For transition_spec, take the two bases of global sections of the restricted locally free sheaf induced by the frames. Their change-of-basis matrices are inverse by Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip. Transport coefficients along the top-section ring isomorphism and frame vectors along restrictAppIso to obtain the frame relation on the original open. Apply the semilinear degree-one coordinate map to the finite sum to obtain the coordinate relation. This includes rank zero and empty opens without additional hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Definition def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section (current blueprint update main-20261015). All compatibility, trivialization, and transition clauses are proved from the stated universal property, relative-spectrum characterization, affine symmetric-algebra comparison, and Mathlib basis-to-polynomial identification. The frame charts are checked by projection and coordinate extensionality and descended using locality of isomorphisms at the target. The functor is now concrete; its equivalence property is transported from the stated object/map characterizations, avoiding reduction of the large chosen existential during geometry.

blueprint_update.statement: A vector bundle of rank $c\geq0$ over a scheme $Z$ is a morphism $\pi:V\to Z$ with $V=\operatorname{Spec}_Z\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_Z}(\mathcal Q)$ for a locally free $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal Q$ of rank $c$. Its zero section $z:Z\to V$ corresponds to the augmentation $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal Q)\to\mathcal O_Z$. A trivialization over an open $U\subseteq Z$ is a basis of $\mathcal Q|_U$; it identifies $V\times_ZU$ with $\Aaf^c_U$ over $U$, carrying $z$ to the zero section. Two trivializations over $U$ differ by a unique matrix in $\mathrm{GL}_c(\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U))$.
